translations.web: Only Yahweh had a delight in your fathers to love them, and he chose their offspring after them, even you above all peoples, as it is today.
translations.bsb: Yet the LORD has set His affection on your fathers and loved them. And He has chosen you, their descendants after them, above all the peoples, even to this day.
translations.kjv: Only the LORD had a delight in thy fathers to love them, and he chose their seed after them, even you above all people, as it is this day.
translations.asv: Only Jehovah had a delight in thy fathers to love them, and he chose their seed after them, even you above all peoples, as at this day.
